newsitem.title: UK: ICI down further on lowered estimates.
newsitem.headline: ICI down further on lowered estimates.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc dropped for a third day on Wednesday as a report in the Financial Times highlighted recent reductions in analyst profit estimates, traders said.

The stock was down 11-1/2p at 834-1/2 by 1229 GMT, continuing a decline since reaching a five-month high of 889p on October 2. "It is just a reaction to the profit downgrades we have seen," said one trader
The FT said analysts were lowering 1996 estimates to around 600 million stg amid pressure on prices for polyester and titanium dioxide.
On Tuesday NatWest cut its 1996 pre-tax profit forecast to 635 million stg from from 700 million, with analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing and BZW already having cut estimates.
